summary: 1 到 4 人动作 roguelike，2026 年 9 月 9 日上市，Underground Cat 开发、Wise Games 发行。商店 AI 披露只有一句：游戏大部分美术与 UI 由 AI 生成。八个领域按这句话登记美术为已使用（同句的 UI 一并计入），游玩时生成、代码、音乐、配音、文本、翻译与营销本次披露未说明。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Underground Cat，发行商 Wise Games）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 126），首页没有命中 AI 关键词的主题，因此没有可读取的相关帖。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源。其一是 Open Credits 本作条目：按领域转录商店披露（Art 标 Mostly AI、Menus/UI/HUD 依据披露、其余标 Not stated），并统计本作 341 条评论中 72% 好评、其中 1 条纯粹讨论 AI 使用且为差评；该站的领域拆分与好评率剔除口径属于其自有算法，本站只登记为第三方读法。其二是 GameAICheck 本作条目：复述商店披露后给出由 deepseek-flash 生成的“Major AI · solid production”判词，并统计该开发商近 12 个月发行 1 款、名下 2 款中 1 款披露 AI，属第三方模型判断与统计，不构成独立核实。其余结果为本作商店页（含带鉴赏家参数的入口）、本作试玩版商店页（App ID 4279730，按政策试玩版不充新增）、一个第三方 AI 披露汇总列表页与另一款游戏（App ID 4580510 United2030）的条目页。检索结果为空只说明本次检索范围，不能据此证明没有 AI。八个领域全部按商店披露原文判定，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 1 到 4 人动作 roguelike：几十名英雄任选，数百个技能与遗物自由组合，单玩或组队一路清怪打 boss。

english.summary: A 1 to 4 player action roguelike released on Sep 9, 2026, developed by Underground Cat and published by Wise Games. The store disclosure is one sentence: most of the game art and UI are generated by AI. Art is recorded as used on that sentence, with the UI counted inside the same wording because the developer gives no separate scope for the interface, and run-time generation, code, music, voice, writing, translation and marketing are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Underground Cat, publisher Wise Games) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 126), where no topic matches the AI keyword set, so there was no related thread to open. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw sources were read. The first is an Open Credits entry that transcribes the disclosure by area, marking art as mostly AI and menus, UI and HUD from the disclosure while leaving the rest not stated, and counts 72 percent positive of 341 Steam reviews with one review that is only about AI use and is negative; that area split and the review filtering are the site own algorithm, logged here as a third-party reading. The second is a GameAICheck entry that restates the store disclosure and then prints a judgment produced by the model deepseek-flash, Major AI with solid production and high confidence, plus its own count of 1 release by this developer in the last 12 months and 1 of their 2 games disclosing AI, which is third-party model output and statistics rather than independent verification. The other results were the store page and its curator-parameter entry, the demo store page for this game (App ID 4279730, which policy excludes from new intake), a third-party aggregate list page and an entry for a different game. An empty press finding only describes this search scope and is not evidence that no AI was used. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text and rests on the developer own statement, without an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.art: The disclosure is the single sentence stating that most of the game art and UI are generated by AI. This site records art as used on that sentence and counts the UI inside the same wording, because the developer puts art and UI in one sentence and gives no separate scope for the interface; how large most is is not stated.
